verse.verse_1: Recite in the name of your Lord Who created,
verse.verse_2: created man from a clot of congealed blood.
verse.verse_3: Recite: and your Lord is Most Generous,
verse.verse_5: taught man what he did not know.
verse.verse_7: for he believes himself to be self-sufficient.
verse.verse_8: Surely to your Lord is your return.
verse.verse_9: Did you see him who forbids
verse.verse_10: a servant (of Allah) when he prays?
verse.verse_11: Did you consider: what if he is on the Right Way,
verse.verse_13: Did you consider: what if he gives the lie (to the Truth) and turns away (from it)?
verse.verse_14: Does he not know that Allah sees everything?
verse.verse_15: No indeed; if he does not desist, We shall drag him by the forelock;
verse.verse_16: by the lying forelock steeped in sin.
verse.verse_17: So let him summon his helpmates;
verse.verse_18: We too shall summon the guards of Hell.
verse.verse_19: No, not at all. Never obey him. But prostrate yourself and become nigh (to your Lord).
